problems: 13 items had no accepted final report (system fallback to MANUAL_REVIEW). They were graded only on R8; all other criteria are NOT_ASSESSABLE per applicability.
20 items carried an identical template report (prediction block, MONITOR, no claims). They were graded with one shared rule; the R7 rationale was adjusted to each question type.

Borderline calls: (a) loose import-table scope wording (e.g. '16/64 visible' when the visible provider total was larger, while claims said 'committed') was scored R2=1, not 0; (b) mild 'score supports benign' phrasing was scored R8=1, while explicit use of the detector output as the main decision basis was scored R8=0.

Whether additional import-page reads were actually offered to each author is not shown. Statements like 'no further tools available' were therefore marked NOT_ASSESSABLE, and ACCESSIBLE_NOT_RETRIEVED was used only where committed entries were demonstrably reachable by bounded page reads.
